# Ezekiel 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-it-was in-the-eleventh year, on-the-first-of the-month, the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**3** Therefore, thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'Behold-Me against-you, Tyre, and-I-will-bring-up against-you many nations, as-the-sea brings-up its-waves.'

**4** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**5** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**18** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**19** For thus says the-Lord YHWH: 'When-I-make-you a-desolate city, like-the-cities which are-not-inhabited, when-I-bring-up the-deep upon-you and-the-great waters cover-you,'

**20** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**21** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Tyre, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **26:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning oracle against Tyre — prophetic context established.

- **26:10**: Central imagery of the proud city cast into the sea — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **26:21**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning Tyre's commerce and destruction.

— EMET
